# AGENTS.md — jFileWork
This file provides context for AI coding agents working on this project.
---
## Project Summary
**jFileWork** is a dual-pane file manager for the local file system, inspired by Total Commander. It is a local desktop application — no server, no network stack.
| Property | Value | |-----------------|-------| | Language | Java 26 (Java-only, no Kotlin) | | UI Framework | JavaFX 23 (OpenJFX) | | Build System | Maven 3.9+ (multi-module) | | JSON Config | Jackson 2.18 | | Logging | SLF4J 2 + Logback 1.5 | | Unit Tests | JUnit 5.11 | | UI Tests | TestFX 4.0.18 + Monocle 21.0.2 (headless) | | Plugin System | `java.util.ServiceLoader` + isolated `URLClassLoader` | | Security | Pragmatic: whitelist + parameter sanitiser (no strong sandbox) |
---
## Maven Module Layout
``` jFileWork/ ← parent POM (packaging=pom) ├── plugin-api/ ← jfilework-plugin-api — stable public API for plugins ├── sample-hash-plugin/ ← jfilework-sample-hash-plugin — demo plugin for M5 ├── core/ ← jfilework-core — file system, commands, config, security └── ui-javafx/ ← jfilework-ui-javafx — JavaFX UI (runnable module) ```
**Build order enforced by Maven:** `plugin-api` → `core` → `ui-javafx`
---
## Key Source Locations
| What | Where | |------|-------| | Application entry point | `ui-javafx/src/main/java/com/github/uscexp/jfilework/ui/javafx/MainLauncher.java` | | JavaFX Application class | `ui-javafx/src/main/java/com/github/uscexp/jfilework/ui/javafx/MainApp.java` | | Main window controller | `ui-javafx/src/main/java/com/github/uscexp/jfilework/ui/javafx/controller/MainWindowController.java` | | Main window FXML | `ui-javafx/src/main/resources/com/github/uscexp/jfilework/ui/javafx/main-window.fxml` | | Logging config | `ui-javafx/src/main/resources/logback.xml` | | UI test base class | `ui-javafx/src/test/java/com/github/uscexp/jfilework/ui/javafx/FxTestBase.java` | | Headless test config | `ui-javafx/src/test/java/com/github/uscexp/jfilework/ui/javafx/HeadlessTestConfig.java` | | Development plan | `PLAN.md` |
---
## Root Package Convention
``` com.github.uscexp.jfilework ├─ core │ ├─ fs (FileService, FileWatcherService, PathResolver) │ ├─ command (Command, CommandContext, CommandRegistry, CommandExecutor, builtin/*) │ ├─ config (AppConfig, UiConfig, CommandBindingConfig, ConfigService) │ ├─ plugin (PluginManager, PluginClassLoaderFactory) │ ├─ security (CommandPolicy, PathPolicy, ParamSanitizer) │ └─ event (EventBus) ├─ ui │ └─ javafx │ ├─ MainApp, MainLauncher │ ├─ controller (MainWindowController, FilePaneController, ...) │ ├─ model (FileItemViewModel, PaneStateViewModel) │ └─ action (UiActionMapper, ToolbarBuilder, MenuBuilder, KeyBindingService) └─ api └─ plugin (CommandPlugin, PluginDescriptor, PluginContext) ```
---
## Build & Run Commands
```bash # Full build (all modules) mvn clean install
# Compile only mvn clean compile
# Run the application (from project root or ui-javafx/) cd ui-javafx && mvn javafx:run
# Run all tests (unit + UI headless via Monocle) mvn test
# Run only unit tests mvn test -Dgroups="!ui"
# Run only UI tests mvn test -Dgroups="ui" ```
---
## Architecture Decisions
### Command System Every user action (built-in, OS or plugin) is a `Command`: ```java public interface Command { String id(); // e.g. "file.copy" boolean canExecute(CommandContext context); CommandResult execute(CommandContext context, Map<String, String> params) throws Exception; } ``` - Commands are registered in `CommandRegistry` at startup. - `CommandExecutor` runs them asynchronously on an `ExecutorService`. - `CommandContext` provides: active/inactive pane, selection snapshot, services, `ProgressSink`, `CancellationToken`.
### UI driven by configuration Toolbar buttons, menu items and hotkeys are **not hard-coded** — they are loaded from `config/app-config.json`: ```json { "actions": [ { "id": "copyToOtherPane", "label": "Copy", "commandId": "file.copy", "params": { "target": "${inactivePane.path}" }, "shortcut": "F5", "placement": ["toolbar.main", "menu.file"] } ] } ``` - `UiActionMapper` resolves `commandId` → `CommandRegistry` → JavaFX action. - Missing command → UI element is **disabled** (never an error dialog). - Parameter templates: `${activePane.path}`, `${inactivePane.path}`, `${selection.paths}`.
### Plugin System - Plugin JARs are placed in the `plugins/` directory. - Discovery: `ServiceLoader<CommandPlugin>`. - Each plugin gets its own `URLClassLoader` (isolation). - Lifecycle: `initialize(PluginContext)` → commands registered → `destroy()` on shutdown. - A faulty plugin is caught and logged; the rest of the application continues.
### Security (pragmatic) - OS commands allowed only when `allowOsCommands: true` in config. - Executable whitelist (`allowedExecutables`) checked before every `os.exec`. - `ParamSanitizer` strips shell meta-characters from template output. - `PathPolicy` ensures resolved paths stay within allowed roots.
---
## UI Test Rules
- All UI tests extend `FxTestBase` (which activates `HeadlessTestConfig`). - Tests that interact with the UI are tagged `@Tag("ui")`. - Use `@TempDir` for any file-system fixtures — never touch real user directories. - Do **not** test business logic in UI tests; that belongs in unit tests.
---
## What NOT to change
| Item | Reason | |------|--------| | `plugin-api` interfaces once published | Plugins compiled against them would break | | `CommandResult` enum values | Used in config and logs | | FXML `fx:id` values | Referenced by controller `@FXML` fields | | `HeadlessTestConfig` property keys | Match Monocle's expected system properties |
---
## Current Milestone Status
| Milestone | Status | |-----------|--------| | M0 — Setup, Maven modules, JavaFX skeleton, TestFX | ✅ Done | | M1 — Dual-pane file view, navigation, selection | ✅ Done | | M2 — Built-in commands (F5–F8, F2) | ✅ Done | | M3 — Config-driven toolbar / menus / hotkeys | ✅ Done | | M4 — OS-command adapter + security | ✅ Done | | M5 — Plugin system + demo plugin | ✅ Done | | M6 — Polishing, packaging, coverage | ⬜ Planned |
Full milestone details: see [`PLAN.md`](PLAN.md).

# jFileWork — Entwicklungsplan
## Technologie-Stack
| Technologie | Verwendung | |---|---| | Java 26 | Implementierungssprache | | JavaFX 23+ (OpenJFX) | UI-Framework | | Jackson | JSON-Konfiguration | | SLF4J + Logback | Logging | | JUnit 5 | Unit- und Integrationstests | | TestFX + Monocle | UI-Tests (headless) | | Maven (Multi-Modul) | Build-System |
---
## Maven-Module
| Modul | Verantwortlichkeit | |---|---| | `core` | Dateisystem-Logik, Command-Engine, Konfiguration, Events, Security, Plugin-Host | | `ui-javafx` | Split-View, Tabellen, Menüs, Toolbar, Keybindings, Theme | | `plugin-api` | Stabile Schnittstellen für externe Command-Plugins |
---
## Paketstruktur
``` com.github.uscexp.jfilework ├─ core │ ├─ fs (FileService, FileWatcherService, PathResolver) │ ├─ command (Command, CommandContext, CommandRegistry, CommandExecutor, builtin/*) │ ├─ config (AppConfig, UiConfig, CommandBindingConfig, ConfigService) │ ├─ plugin (Plugin, PluginDescriptor, PluginManager, PluginClassLoaderFactory) │ ├─ security (CommandPolicy, PathPolicy) │ └─ event (EventBus) ├─ ui │ └─ javafx │ ├─ MainApp │ ├─ controller (MainWindowController, FilePaneController, ProgressDialogController, ...) │ ├─ model (FileItemViewModel, PaneStateViewModel) │ └─ action (UiActionMapper, ToolbarBuilder, MenuBuilder, KeyBindingService) └─ api └─ plugin (CommandPlugin, PluginContext) ```
---
## Konfigurationsdesign (`config/app-config.json`)
```json { "ui": { "theme": "dark", "showHiddenFiles": false, "leftStartPath": "C:/", "rightStartPath": "D:/" }, "actions": [ { "id": "copyToOtherPane", "label": "Copy", "icon": "copy", "commandId": "file.copy", "params": { "target": "${inactivePane.path}" }, "shortcut": "F5", "placement": ["toolbar.main", "menu.file"] }, { "id": "zipWith7z", "label": "Zip (7z)", "commandId": "os.exec", "params": { "exe": "C:/Program Files/7-Zip/7z.exe", "args": "a ${activePane.path}/archive.7z ${selection.paths}" }, "placement": ["menu.tools"] } ], "plugins": { "directory": "plugins", "enabled": ["sample-hash-plugin"] }, "security": { "allowOsCommands": true, "allowedExecutables": [ "C:/Program Files/7-Zip/7z.exe", "C:/Windows/System32/robocopy.exe" ] } } ```
---
## Plugin-API
```java public interface CommandPlugin { PluginDescriptor descriptor(); void initialize(PluginContext context); List<Command> commands(); } ```
---
## Sicherheit (pragmatisch)
- OS-Kommandos nur wenn `allowOsCommands=true` - Executable-Whitelist vor Ausführung geprüft - Parameter-Sanitizer gegen Shell-Injection - `PathPolicy`: Pfade nur innerhalb erlaubter Roots - Lange Operationen nur async (`ExecutorService` + `CancellationToken`)
---
## UI-Test-Prinzipien
| Prinzip | Details | |---|---| | **Headless via Monocle** | `-Dglass.platform=Monocle`, CI-tauglich ohne Display | | **`@TempDir` Fixture-FS** | Temporäre Verzeichnisstrukturen, keine Produktivdaten | | **`FxTestBase`** | App-Start, Stage, FxRobot, sauberes Beenden | | **Scope** | Interaktionsebene — keine Business-Logik die Unit-Tests abdecken | | **Separierbar** | UI-Tests per `@Tag("ui")` von Unit-Tests trennbar |
---
## Meilenstein-Backlog
### Milestone 0 — Projekt-Setup & Fundament > **Ziel:** Lauffähiges Projekt-Skeleton, alle Werkzeuge konfiguriert, erstes JavaFX-Fenster öffnet sich.
| # | Story | Artefakte | |---|-------|-----------| | 0.1 | `pom.xml` auf Java 26, JavaFX 23+, Jackson, SLF4J/Logback, JUnit 5 erweitern | `pom.xml` | | 0.2 | Maven-Modulstruktur anlegen: `core`, `ui-javafx`, `plugin-api` als Sub-Module im Parent-POM | `pom.xml` (parent + 3×module) | | 0.3 | `Main.java` als JavaFX-Startpunkt (`Application.launch`) umbauen | `Main.java` | | 0.4 | Leeres Hauptfenster (800×600, SplitPane 50/50) mit Dummy-Inhalt anzeigen | `MainApp.java`, `main-window.fxml` | | 0.5 | Logging-Konfiguration, `.gitignore` vervollständigen | `logback.xml`, `.gitignore` | | 0.6 | Basis-`README.md` mit Build- und Run-Anleitung | `README.md` | | 0.7 | TestFX + Monocle (Headless-JavaFX) als Test-Dependencies in `pom.xml` konfigurieren | `pom.xml` | | 0.8 | Basis-Testhelfer anlegen: `FxTestBase`, `HeadlessTestConfig` | `FxTestBase`, `HeadlessTestConfig` |
---
### Milestone 1 — Dual-Pane Dateiansicht > **Ziel:** Beide Panels zeigen das Dateisystem navigierbar an.
| # | Story | Kernsymbole | |---|-------|-------------| | 1.1 | `FileService` implementieren: `listDirectory`, `exists`, `isDirectory`, `getMetadata` via `java.nio.file` | `FileService` | | 1.2 | `FileItemViewModel` (Name, Größe, Datum, Typ, Pfad, Icon-Hint) als JavaFX-Property-Modell | `FileItemViewModel` | | 1.3 | `PaneStateViewModel` (aktueller Pfad, Sortierung, Filter, Auswahl-Liste) | `PaneStateViewModel` | | 1.4 | `FilePaneController` mit `TableView<FileItemViewModel>`: Spalten Name, Größe, Datum, Typ | `FilePaneController`, `file-pane.fxml` | | 1.5 | Navigation: Doppelklick auf Ordner wechselt Verzeichnis, `..` geht hoch | `FilePaneController` | | 1.6 | Breadcrumb / Pfad-Eingabefeld oben je Pane (direkte Eingabe möglich) | `FilePaneController` | | 1.7 | Einzel- und Multi-Selektion (Maus + Shift/Ctrl) | `PaneStateViewModel` | | 1.8 | Sortierung je Spalte (klickbar) | `FilePaneController` | | 1.9 | `ActivePaneTracker` — merkt, welche Seite zuletzt Fokus hatte | `ActivePaneTracker` | | 1.10 | `FileWatcherService` — Verzeichnis-Änderungen triggern automatisches Reload der Pane | `FileWatcherService` | | 1.11 | Unit-Tests für `FileService` mit JUnit 5 `@TempDir` | `FileServiceTest` | | 1.12 | UI-Test: Fenster öffnet sich, beide Panes sichtbar, SplitPane korrekt geteilt | `MainWindowUiTest` | | 1.13 | UI-Test: Navigation per Doppelklick wechselt Pfad in Breadcrumb | `FilePaneNavigationUiTest` | | 1.14 | UI-Test: Multi-Selektion via Shift/Ctrl korrekt in `PaneStateViewModel` | `FilePaneSelectionUiTest` |
---
### Milestone 2 — Built-in Commands & Command-Engine > **Ziel:** Alle klassischen Dateioperationen funktionieren intern. Command-System steht.
| # | Story | Kernsymbole | |---|-------|-------------| | 2.1 | `Command`-Interface: `id()`, `execute(CommandContext, Map<String,String>)`, `canExecute(CommandContext)` | `Command` | | 2.2 | `CommandContext`: aktive/inaktive Pane, Auswahl-Snapshot, Services, `ProgressSink`, `CancellationToken` | `CommandContext`, `SelectionSnapshot` | | 2.3 | `CommandResult` (SUCCESS, PARTIAL, FAILED, CANCELLED + Nachricht) | `CommandResult` | | 2.4 | `CommandRegistry`: Commands registrieren, per ID abrufen | `CommandRegistry` | | 2.5 | `CommandExecutor`: async auf `ExecutorService`, Progress-Callback, Fehlerbehandlung | `CommandExecutor` | | 2.6 | Built-in Command `file.copy` (F5): in inaktive Pane mit Überschreib-Dialog | `CopyCommand` | | 2.7 | Built-in Command `file.move` (F6): copy + delete | `MoveCommand` | | 2.8 | Built-in Command `file.mkdir` (F7): Verzeichnis anlegen mit Namens-Dialog | `MkdirCommand` | | 2.9 | Built-in Command `file.delete` (F8): Bestätigungsdialog, sicheres Löschen | `DeleteCommand` | | 2.10 | Built-in Command `file.rename` (F2/Shift+F6): in-place oder Dialog | `RenameCommand` | | 2.11 | Progress-Dialog mit Cancel-Button für lange Operationen | `ProgressDialogController` | | 2.12 | Toast/Statusbar-Feedback für schnelle Operationen | `StatusBarController` | | 2.13 | Unit-Tests für alle Built-in Commands mit `@TempDir` | `*CommandTest` | | 2.14 | UI-Test: F5 öffnet Copy-Bestätigungsdialog, Datei erscheint danach in Ziel-Pane | `CopyCommandUiTest` | | 2.15 | UI-Test: F8 öffnet Lösch-Dialog, Cancel bricht ab ohne Änderung | `DeleteCommandUiTest` | | 2.16 | UI-Test: Progress-Dialog erscheint bei langer Operation, Cancel-Button bricht ab | `ProgressDialogUiTest` |
---
### Milestone 3 — Konfigurierbare UI (Menüs, Toolbar, Hotkeys) > **Ziel:** Toolbar, Menüleiste und Shortcuts werden vollständig aus JSON-Konfiguration aufgebaut.
| # | Story | Kernsymbole | |---|-------|-------------| | 3.1 | JSON-Schema für `config/app-config.json` definieren und dokumentieren | `app-config.json`, `config-schema.md` | | 3.2 | `AppConfig`, `UiConfig`, `CommandBindingConfig`, `ActionConfig` als Jackson-POJOs | `AppConfig`, `ActionConfig` | | 3.3 | `ConfigService`: laden, validieren, speichern, Defaults mergen | `ConfigService` | | 3.4 | `UiActionMapper`: liest Actions aus Config, sucht Command in Registry, erstellt JavaFX-Actions | `UiActionMapper` | | 3.5 | Dynamischer Toolbar-Builder aus Config (`placement: ["toolbar.main"]`) | `ToolbarBuilder` | | 3.6 | Dynamischer Menüleisten-Builder aus Config (`placement: ["menu.file"]`) | `MenuBuilder` | | 3.7 | Hotkey-Binding aus Config (`shortcut: "F5"`) via JavaFX `KeyCombination` | `KeyBindingService` | | 3.8 | Nicht-vorhandene Commands → UI-Element disabled + Log-Warnung | `UiActionMapper` | | 3.9 | Parameter-Template-Engine: `${activePane.path}`, `${inactivePane.path}`, `${selection.paths}` | `ParamTemplateEngine` | | 3.10 | UI-Einstellungen-Dialog (Theme, versteckte Dateien, Startpfade) | `PreferencesController` | | 3.11 | Persistenz: letzter Fensterzustand und Pfad je Pane beim Start wiederherstellen | `SessionService` | | 3.12 | UI-Test: Toolbar-Button aus Config erscheint und löst korrekten Command aus | `ToolbarConfigUiTest` | | 3.13 | UI-Test: Hotkey (z. B. F5) löst Command aus ohne Mausklick | `HotkeyBindingUiTest` | | 3.14 | UI-Test: nicht vorhandenes Command → Button disabled | `DisabledActionUiTest` |
---
### Milestone 4 — OS-Command-Adapter & Sicherheit > **Ziel:** Externe Programme als Commands einbindbar. Sicherheitsregeln greifen.
| # | Story | Kernsymbole | |---|-------|-------------| | 4.1 | `OsExecCommand` (`os.exec`): startet externen Prozess mit Parametern, fängt stdout/stderr | `OsExecCommand` | | 4.2 | `CommandPolicy`: prüft ob `os.exec` erlaubt (`allowOsCommands`-Flag) | `CommandPolicy` | | 4.3 | `PathPolicy`: validiert, dass Pfade innerhalb erlaubter Roots liegen | `PathPolicy` | | 4.4 | Executable-Whitelist: `allowedExecutables`-Liste in Config, Prüfung vor Ausführung | `CommandPolicy` | | 4.5 | Parameter-Sanitizer: verhindert Shell-Injection in Template-Auflösung | `ParamSanitizer` | | 4.6 | Prozess-Output-Fenster: stdout/stderr live anzeigen, Prozess killbar | `ProcessOutputController` | | 4.7 | Policy-Verletzung → klar verständlicher Dialog + Log-Entry | `CommandExecutor`, `PolicyException` | | 4.8 | Konfigurations-Beispiele für 7-Zip, Notepad++, Git-Bash in `README.md` | `README.md` | | 4.9 | UI-Test: Prozess-Output-Fenster zeigt Live-Ausgabe, Kill-Button beendet Prozess | `ProcessOutputUiTest` | | 4.10 | UI-Test: Policy-Verletzung zeigt Fehlerdialog | `PolicyViolationUiTest` |
---
### Milestone 5 — Plugin-System > **Ziel:** Externe JARs liefern neue Commands, werden sicher geladen und in UI integriert.
| # | Story | Kernsymbole | |---|-------|-------------| | 5.1 | `plugin-api` Modul stabilisieren: `CommandPlugin`, `PluginDescriptor`, `PluginContext` (nur sichere Facades) | `CommandPlugin`, `PluginContext` | | 5.2 | API-Versionierung: semantische Version in `PluginDescriptor`, Kompatibilitätsprüfung beim Laden | `PluginDescriptor`, `PluginManager` | | 5.3 | `PluginClassLoaderFactory`: isolierter `URLClassLoader` je Plugin | `PluginClassLoaderFactory` | | 5.4 | `PluginManager`: Discovery via `ServiceLoader<CommandPlugin>` aus `plugins/`-Ordner | `PluginManager` | | 5.5 | Plugin-Lifecycle: `initialize(PluginContext)` → Commands registrieren → `destroy()` | `PluginManager` | | 5.6 | Inkompatibles/fehlerhaftes Plugin isoliert abfangen, Rest läuft weiter | `PluginManager` | | 5.7 | Plugin-Liste in Einstellungen anzeigen (Name, Version, Status, En-/Disable) | `PluginSettingsController` | | 5.8 | Demo-Plugin `hash-plugin`: berechnet MD5/SHA-256 für gewählte Dateien, zeigt Ergebnis | `HashPlugin`, `HashCommand` | | 5.9 | Plugin-Entwickler-Doku: wie schreibe ich ein Plugin, wie paketiere ich es | `PLUGIN_DEV.md` | | 5.10 | UI-Test: Demo-Plugin erscheint in Plugin-Liste als aktiv | `PluginSettingsUiTest` | | 5.11 | UI-Test: Hash-Command aus Plugin taucht in Toolbar auf (wenn konfiguriert) und liefert Ergebnis-Dialog | `HashPluginUiTest` |

### Milestone 6 — Polishing, UX & Stabilisierung > **Ziel:** Produktionsreife Qualität, angenehmere UX, vollständige Dokumentation.

# jFileWork — Entwicklungsplan
## Technologie-Stack
| Technologie | Verwendung | |---|---| | Java 26 | Implementierungssprache | | JavaFX 23+ (OpenJFX) | UI-Framework | | Jackson | JSON-Konfiguration | | SLF4J + Logback | Logging | | JUnit 5 | Unit- und Integrationstests | | TestFX + Monocle | UI-Tests (headless) | | Maven (Multi-Modul) | Build-System |
---
## Maven-Module
| Modul | Verantwortlichkeit | |---|---| | `core` | Dateisystem-Logik, Command-Engine, Konfiguration, Events, Security, Plugin-Host | | `ui-javafx` | Split-View, Tabellen, Menüs, Toolbar, Keybindings, Theme | | `plugin-api` | Stabile Schnittstellen für externe Command-Plugins |
---
## Paketstruktur
``` com.github.uscexp.jfilework ├─ core │ ├─ fs (FileService, FileWatcherService, PathResolver) │ ├─ command (Command, CommandContext, CommandRegistry, CommandExecutor, builtin/*) │ ├─ config (AppConfig, UiConfig, CommandBindingConfig, ConfigService) │ ├─ plugin (Plugin, PluginDescriptor, PluginManager, PluginClassLoaderFactory) │ ├─ security (CommandPolicy, PathPolicy) │ └─ event (EventBus) ├─ ui │ └─ javafx │ ├─ MainApp │ ├─ controller (MainWindowController, FilePaneController, ProgressDialogController, ...) │ ├─ model (FileItemViewModel, PaneStateViewModel) │ └─ action (UiActionMapper, ToolbarBuilder, MenuBuilder, KeyBindingService) └─ api └─ plugin (CommandPlugin, PluginContext) ```
---
## Konfigurationsdesign (`config/app-config.json`)
```json { "ui": { "theme": "dark", "showHiddenFiles": false, "leftStartPath": "C:/", "rightStartPath": "D:/" }, "actions": [ { "id": "copyToOtherPane", "label": "Copy", "icon": "copy", "commandId": "file.copy", "params": { "target": "${inactivePane.path}" }, "shortcut": "F5", "placement": ["toolbar.main", "menu.file"] }, { "id": "zipWith7z", "label": "Zip (7z)", "commandId": "os.exec", "params": { "exe": "C:/Program Files/7-Zip/7z.exe", "args": "a ${activePane.path}/archive.7z ${selection.paths}" }, "placement": ["menu.tools"] } ], "plugins": { "directory": "plugins", "enabled": ["sample-hash-plugin"] }, "security": { "allowOsCommands": true, "allowedExecutables": [ "C:/Program Files/7-Zip/7z.exe", "C:/Windows/System32/robocopy.exe" ] } } ```
---
## Plugin-API
```java public interface CommandPlugin { PluginDescriptor descriptor(); void initialize(PluginContext context); List<Command> commands(); } ```
---
## Sicherheit (pragmatisch)
- OS-Kommandos nur wenn `allowOsCommands=true` - Executable-Whitelist vor Ausführung geprüft - Parameter-Sanitizer gegen Shell-Injection - `PathPolicy`: Pfade nur innerhalb erlaubter Roots - Lange Operationen nur async (`ExecutorService` + `CancellationToken`)
---
## UI-Test-Prinzipien
| Prinzip | Details | |---|---| | **Headless via Monocle** | `-Dglass.platform=Monocle`, CI-tauglich ohne Display | | **`@TempDir` Fixture-FS** | Temporäre Verzeichnisstrukturen, keine Produktivdaten | | **`FxTestBase`** | App-Start, Stage, FxRobot, sauberes Beenden | | **Scope** | Interaktionsebene — keine Business-Logik die Unit-Tests abdecken | | **Separierbar** | UI-Tests per `@Tag("ui")` von Unit-Tests trennbar |

# jFileWork
A **dual-pane file manager** for the local file system — inspired by Total Commander. Built with **Java 26** and **JavaFX 23**, featuring a fully configuration-driven UI and a JAR plugin system.
---
## Project Structure
``` jFileWork/ ← Parent POM (multi-module) ├── plugin-api/ ← Stable public API for external plugins ├── sample-hash-plugin/ ← Demo plugin contributing SHA-256 commands ├── core/ ← File system logic, command engine, config, security └── ui-javafx/ ← JavaFX dual-pane UI (this is the runnable module) ```
See [`PLAN.md`](PLAN.md) for the full milestone-based development roadmap.
---
## Prerequisites
| Tool | Version | |-------------|----------| | JDK | 26+ | | Maven | 3.9+ |
---
## Build
```bash # From the project root mvn clean install ```
---
## Run
```bash cd ui-javafx mvn javafx:run ```
---
## Test
```bash # All tests (unit + UI headless via Monocle) mvn test
# Only unit tests (skip UI tag) mvn test -Dgroups="!ui"
# Only UI tests mvn test -Dgroups="ui" ```
---
## Configuration
The application is configured via `config/app-config.json`.
### Security for external commands
`os.exec` is disabled by default. To enable it, add a `security` section with an explicit allow-list:
```json { "security": { "allowOsCommands": true, "allowedExecutables": [ "C:/Program Files/7-Zip/7z.exe", "C:/Program Files/Notepad++/notepad++.exe", "C:/Program Files/Git/bin/bash.exe" ], "allowedRoots": [ "C:/Users/andreas.eisenhauer" ] } } ```
### Example actions
Toolbar button that calls 7-Zip:
```json { "security": { "allowOsCommands": true, "allowedExecutables": ["C:/Program Files/7-Zip/7z.exe"], "allowedRoots": ["C:/Users/andreas.eisenhauer"] }, "actions": [ { "id": "zipWith7z", "label": "Zip (7z)", "commandId": "os.exec", "params": { "exe": "C:/Program Files/7-Zip/7z.exe", "args": "a archive.7z ${selection.paths}" }, "placement": ["menu.tools"] } ] } ```
Open the selected file in Notepad++:
```json { "security": { "allowOsCommands": true, "allowedExecutables": ["C:/Program Files/Notepad++/notepad++.exe"] }, "actions": [ { "id": "openInNotepadPlusPlus", "label": "Open in Notepad++", "commandId": "os.exec", "params": { "exe": "C:/Program Files/Notepad++/notepad++.exe", "args": "${selection.paths}" }, "placement": ["menu.tools", "toolbar.main"] } ] } ```
Run a Git Bash command inside the active pane:
```json { "security": { "allowOsCommands": true, "allowedExecutables": ["C:/Program Files/Git/bin/bash.exe"] }, "actions": [ { "id": "gitStatus", "label": "Git Status", "commandId": "os.exec", "params": { "exe": "C:/Program Files/Git/bin/bash.exe", "args": "-lc \"git status\"" }, "placement": ["menu.tools"] } ] } ```
---
## Plugins
Plugins are discovered via `ServiceLoader<CommandPlugin>`.
Minimal plugin configuration:
```json { "plugins": { "directory": "plugins", "enabled": ["sample-hash-plugin"] }, "actions": [ { "id": "hashSelection", "label": "Hash Selection", "commandId": "plugin.hash.sha256", "params": {}, "placement": ["toolbar.main", "menu.tools"] } ] } ```
For development and tests, the plugin loader also accepts subdirectories that contain compiled classes plus `META-INF/services`.
See [`PLUGIN_DEV.md`](PLUGIN_DEV.md) for the plugin development guide.
---
## UX Notes (M6)
- Each side now uses tabs, so multiple directories can stay open in parallel. - Use `View -> New Left Tab`, `View -> New Right Tab`, and `View -> Close Active Tab`. - `F3` opens quick preview for text and image files. - Binary files and very large text files show a safe hint instead of loading full content.
---
## Development Milestones
| Milestone | Focus | |-----------|-------| | **M0** ✅ | Project setup, Maven modules, JavaFX skeleton, TestFX | | **M1** ✅ | Dual-pane file view, navigation, selection | | **M2** ✅ | Built-in commands (F5 Copy, F6 Move, F7 Mkdir, F8 Delete, F2 Rename) | | **M3** ✅ | Config-driven toolbar, menus, hotkeys, preferences and session persistence | | **M4** ✅ | OS-command adapter + pragmatic security rules | | **M5** ✅ | Plugin system (ServiceLoader, isolated loader, demo plugin) | | **M6** | Polishing, tabs, drag & drop, native packaging (tabs + preview + drag/drop done) |
